limit: Found by a code review, not by a failing build; each check now has a unit case or a control.

evidence.quote: the leftovers allowed only as the census found them

evidence.text: Added: the return PC, no jump into a replaced instruction, no site rewritten, every executed hook store form modelled, the boot on through the tail's restore; each control by its own failure.
evidence.quote: no site rewritten, every hook store form modelled
